:::: {.featured-pub}
::: {.featured-label}
★ Featured publication
:::
A. Dubovskaya, C.B. Pena & **D.J.P. O'Sullivan** (2025).
[Modeling diffusion in networks with communities: A multitype branching process approach](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevE.111.034310).
*Physical Review E*, 111(3), 034310.

A multitype branching process framework for modelling how information and behaviour diffuse through networks with community structure, extending our earlier work to capture the interplay between diffusion dynamics and mesoscale network organisation.
::::
